scope: Read-only condensed React quality review of six current changed TSX/hook sources and affected helper/callers. Default warning changes frozen. No source modifications.

findings.title: Remove selected node from page requests when it is absent from the query key
findings.trigger: Select a visible node on a byte-bound graph page, then navigate its next edge page. selected was removed from queryKey but queryFn still sends node=selected.
findings.effect: The server duplicates selected detail into its base payload, reduces byte-bound node page membership, and rejects the previous edge cursor because its node-page hash changed. A subsequent reload may also change node membership under the same query key.

reproduction.fixture: Existing synthetic_graph/build_graph_shards exporter, 200 nodes/1000 edges; legal 4000-emoji summary, 512-emoji label/displayTitle, 16 evidence entries per node; limit=100/edgeLimit=1

findings.suggestion: Remove node=selected from the paginated queryFn: current detail already reads the selected node from data.nodes. Keep selection outside the page query key to retain its intended zero-fetch selection behavior.
findings.status: Fixed with separately authorized one-line page query change
